mediaReview.title: Media review
mediaReview.uploadResult: {{received}} file(s) received, {{failed}} failed. Files remain private until approved.
mediaReview.reconciled: The receipt confirms that the request was recorded. Data has been refreshed.
mediaReview.subtitle: Shared rules, one gallery and individual review for exceptions.
mediaReview.chooseMedia: Choose an image to review its content and exceptions.
mediaReview.reviewRestrictions: I reviewed the usage restrictions for this image.
mediaReview.manualReview: Human review remains available without AI. Accepting media does not authorize publication.
mediaReview.websiteExposure: This media will be selected for the website. It may become visible immediately if the dossier is already visible and eligible. This action does not authorize any social publication.
mediaReview.websiteRemoval: This action removes this media from website display. It does not delete the file or change any social publication.
mediaReview.rulesHelp: Permissions require real evidence. Automated analysis cannot grant legal rights.
mediaReview.coverage: The evidence must cover these {{count}} files. Future files are not included automatically.
mediaReview.futureCoverage: The supplied evidence also covers future files in this dossier or batch. I explicitly authorize those files to inherit these rules.
mediaReview.planHelp: Review the exact content of these {{count}} files and their permissions before confirming.
mediaReview.blockedPlan: This selection contains blockers. Resolve them or remove the affected media before preparing another decision.
mediaReview.noPublication: This decision does not schedule or publish content. Distribution requires its own authorization.
mediaReview.manifestConfirmation: I reviewed the files, alternative text, permissions and restrictions. I confirm this action on the exact selection shown.
mediaReview.uncertainHelp: The request outcome is uncertain. Changes are suspended until its receipt is verified. Do not repeat the operation elsewhere.
mediaReview.noReceipt: No confirmed receipt yet. Check again without repeating the operation.
mediaReview.historyPrivate: Private history of rights, decisions and operations.
mediaReview.inheritConfirm: Confirm restoring inherited permissions for this media.

errors.loadFailed: Media could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.planFailed: The decision could not be prepared. Refresh the media before trying again.
errors.changed: The dossier changed or the decision was refused. Review the refreshed information.
errors.uncertain: The receipt has not been confirmed.
errors.forbidden: Your permissions do not allow this action.

reasons.MEDIA_USAGE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Evidence of usage permission is required.
reasons.MODERATION_RESTRICTED: A moderation restriction blocks this media.
reasons.MEDIA_ANALYSIS_FAILED: Analysis failed: human review is required.

analysis.title: Analysis and proposals
analysis.technicalOnly: Local technical analysis is available. Vision and OCR are not configured; no visual content or legal rights are inferred.
analysis.assisted: A person must verify proposals. They grant neither legal rights nor media approval.
analysis.error: Analysis or its review is unavailable. Manual review remains available.
